create_planner_cube_orientation: create a predictive sampling planner for cube orientation with shadow hand model and custom reward function
run_cube_orientation_simulation: run a 500-step MuJoCo simulation using predictive sampling planner to orient a cube with a shadow hand
define_reward_cube_orientation: define a reward function combining position error, orientation error, velocity, effort, grasp, and joint velocity terms
improve_policy_predictive_sampling: improve the predictive sampling policy with current state, actuation, time, and mocap pose inputs
get_action_from_policy: get control actions from the predictive sampling planner at a given simulation time
